decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of work.
Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 4 Benham Gardens.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern and southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. Amended plan, unnumbered, received 08.07.03 shall be provided before the work the subject of this approval is completed and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Erection of two storey side and two storey rear extension and part single storey side extension to dwellinghouse.
